# Data dictionary

## `bronze_ecb_fx_rates`

*bronze streaming table, pipeline: `src/pipeline/bronze/bronze_market_data.sql`*

Raw ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (dataflow EXR), one row per landed observation. Lineage: ECB Data Portal API -> landing volume /ecb -> this table.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | STRING | Data provider, always ECB |
| `series_id` | STRING | ECB SDMX series key, e.g. EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A |
| `currency` | STRING | Quoted currency (ISO 4217) |
| `obs_date` | DATE | Reference rate date (TARGET business day) |
| `value` | DOUBLE | Units of currency per 1 EUR |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | UTC time the ingestion task fetched the data |
| `source_file` | STRING | Landing file the row was read from |
| `loaded_at` | TIMESTAMP | Time the pipeline loaded the row into bronze |

## `bronze_index_prices`

*bronze streaming table, pipeline: `src/pipeline/bronze/bronze_market_data.sql`*

Raw equity index closing levels from FRED, one row per landed observation (holidays arrive as null values). Lineage: FRED fredgraph.csv -> landing volume /fred -> this table.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | STRING | Data provider, always FRED |
| `series_id` | STRING | FRED series id, e.g. SP500 |
| `currency` | STRING | Index quote currency (ISO 4217) |
| `obs_date` | DATE | Trading date |
| `value` | DOUBLE | Index closing level in quote currency; null on market holidays |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | UTC time the ingestion task fetched the data |
| `source_file` | STRING | Landing file the row was read from |
| `loaded_at` | TIMESTAMP | Time the pipeline loaded the row into bronze |

## `silver_index_prices`

*silver materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/silver/silver_market_data.sql`*

Daily equity index closes, one row per (risk_factor_id, price_date); holidays removed. Lineage: bronze_index_prices + silver_risk_factors.

## `gold_dim_date`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_dimensions.sql`*

Calendar dimension spanning all market data dates. Lineage: silver_fx_rates + silver_index_prices.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `calendar_date` | DATE | Calendar date (primary key) |
| `year` | INT | Calendar year |
| `quarter` | INT | Calendar quarter 1-4 |
| `month` | INT | Month number 1-12 |
| `month_name` | STRING | Short month name, e.g. Oct |
| `year_month` | STRING | yyyy-MM, sortable month label |
| `day_of_week` | INT | ISO day of week, Monday = 1 ... Sunday = 7 |
| `day_name` | STRING | Short day name, e.g. Mon |
| `is_weekend` | BOOLEAN | Saturday or Sunday |
| `is_ecb_fixing_day` | BOOLEAN | ECB published reference rates on this date (TARGET business day) |
| `is_us_trading_day` | BOOLEAN | At least one USD equity index has a close on this date |

## `gold_fact_market_prices_eur`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_market_data.sql`*

Daily EUR prices per risk factor on a weekday grid with as-of filled local closes and ECB rates. Lineage: silver_index_prices + silver_fx_rates + silver_risk_factors + gold_dim_date.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` | DATE | Valuation date (weekday grid) |
| `risk_factor_id` | STRING | Risk factor (FK gold_dim_risk_factor) |
| `asset_class` | STRING | EQUITY_INDEX or FX |
| `quote_currency` | STRING | Currency of the local price |
| `local_price` | DOUBLE | Index level in quote currency; 1.0 for FX factors (one unit of currency) |
| `fx_rate` | DOUBLE | ECB rate used: units of quote currency per 1 EUR (1.0 for EUR) |
| `price_eur` | DOUBLE | Price in EUR = local_price / fx_rate |
| `local_price_age_days` | INT | Calendar days since the local close was observed (0 = same day) |
| `fx_rate_age_days` | INT | Calendar days since the ECB rate was observed (0 = same day) |
| `is_filled` | BOOLEAN | True if the local price or the FX rate was carried forward |

## `gold_fact_risk_factor_returns`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_market_data.sql`*

Daily EUR returns per risk factor; the scenario set for historical VaR. Lineage: gold_fact_market_prices_eur.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` | DATE | Return end date |
| `risk_factor_id` | STRING | Risk factor (FK gold_dim_risk_factor) |
| `prev_price_date` | DATE | Return start date (previous available grid date) |
| `price_eur` | DOUBLE | EUR price at price_date |
| `prev_price_eur` | DOUBLE | EUR price at prev_price_date |
| `simple_return` | DOUBLE | price_eur / prev_price_eur - 1 |
| `log_return` | DOUBLE | ln(price_eur / prev_price_eur) |
| `days_since_prev` | INT | Calendar days between prev_price_date and price_date |

## `gold_fact_position_pnl_daily`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_exposure_pnl.sql`*

Daily hypothetical P&L per position in EUR. Lineage: silver_positions + gold_fact_risk_factor_returns.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pnl_date` | DATE | P&L date (end of the return period) |
| `prev_date` | DATE | Start of the return period |
| `position_id` | STRING | Position (FK gold_dim_position) |
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `risk_factor_id` | STRING | Risk factor (FK gold_dim_risk_factor) |
| `exposure_prev_eur` | DOUBLE | EUR market value at prev_date |
| `simple_return` | DOUBLE | EUR return of the risk factor over the period |
| `pnl_eur` | DOUBLE | Hypothetical P&L = quantity * (price_eur - prev_price_eur) |

## `gold_fact_portfolio_pnl_daily`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_exposure_pnl.sql`*

Daily hypothetical portfolio P&L in EUR; only dates where every position has a return. This is the realised series the VaR backtest compares against. Lineage: gold_fact_position_pnl_daily + silver_positions.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pnl_date` | DATE | P&L date |
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `portfolio_value_prev_eur` | DOUBLE | Portfolio market value at the start of the period |
| `pnl_eur` | DOUBLE | Hypothetical portfolio P&L in EUR (sum over positions) |
| `return_pct` | DOUBLE | pnl_eur / gross exposure at start of period |
| `n_positions` | BIGINT | Positions contributing on this date |
| `n_positions_expected` | BIGINT | Positions in the portfolio |

## `gold_fact_position_exposure_daily`

*gold materialized view, pipeline: `src/pipeline/gold/gold_exposure_pnl.sql`*

Daily market value of every position in EUR. Lineage: silver_positions + gold_fact_market_prices_eur.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `as_of_date` | DATE | Valuation date |
| `position_id` | STRING | Position (FK gold_dim_position) |
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `risk_factor_id` | STRING | Risk factor (FK gold_dim_risk_factor) |
| `quote_currency` | STRING | Currency of the risk factor |
| `quantity` | DOUBLE | Index units or currency units; negative = short |
| `local_price` | DOUBLE | Price in quote currency |
| `fx_rate` | DOUBLE | Units of quote currency per 1 EUR |
| `price_eur` | DOUBLE | Price in EUR |
| `exposure_local` | DOUBLE | quantity * local_price, in quote currency |

## `gold_fact_var_daily`

*gold delta table, risk job: `src/market_risk/jobs/compute_risk.py`*

Daily 1-day VaR and Expected Shortfall per portfolio, method and confidence level.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `as_of_date` | DATE | Date the forecast is made (end of day), using returns up to this date |
| `method` | STRING | Risk model (FK gold_dim_risk_method) |
| `confidence_level` | DOUBLE | VaR / ES confidence level, e.g. 0.99 |
| `forecast_date` | DATE | Next trading date the forecast applies to (null for the latest as_of_date) |
| `window_days` | INT | Number of daily return scenarios used |
| `horizon_days` | INT | Risk horizon in days (1) |
| `portfolio_value_eur` | DOUBLE | Net market value of the portfolio in EUR |
| `gross_exposure_eur` | DOUBLE | Sum of absolute exposures in EUR |
| `var_eur` | DOUBLE | Value at Risk, positive EUR loss |
| `es_eur` | DOUBLE | Expected Shortfall (average loss beyond VaR), positive EUR |
| `var_pct` | DOUBLE | VaR / gross exposure |
| `es_pct` | DOUBLE | ES / gross exposure |
| `computed_at` | TIMESTAMP | UTC time the risk job ran |
| `run_id` | STRING | Risk job run identifier |

## `gold_fact_risk_contribution`

*gold delta table, risk job: `src/market_risk/jobs/compute_risk.py`*

Risk factor contributions: ES contributions for historical simulation, Euler VaR contributions for parametric methods. Contributions sum to the portfolio total.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `as_of_date` | DATE | Date the forecast is made (end of day), using returns up to this date |
| `method` | STRING | Risk model (FK gold_dim_risk_method) |
| `confidence_level` | DOUBLE | VaR / ES confidence level, e.g. 0.99 |
| `risk_factor_id` | STRING | Risk factor (FK gold_dim_risk_factor) |
| `exposure_eur` | DOUBLE | Portfolio exposure to the risk factor in EUR |
| `contribution_measure` | STRING | ES (historical) or VaR (parametric) |
| `contribution_eur` | DOUBLE | Contribution to the measure in EUR |
| `contribution_pct` | DOUBLE | Share of the portfolio measure |

## `gold_fact_var_backtest`

*gold delta table, risk job: `src/market_risk/jobs/compute_risk.py`*

VaR forecasts made at as_of_date compared with the realised hypothetical P&L on forecast_date.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `as_of_date` | DATE | Date the forecast is made (end of day), using returns up to this date |
| `method` | STRING | Risk model (FK gold_dim_risk_method) |
| `confidence_level` | DOUBLE | VaR / ES confidence level, e.g. 0.99 |
| `forecast_date` | DATE | Date of the realised P&L |
| `var_eur` | DOUBLE | VaR forecast, positive EUR |
| `es_eur` | DOUBLE | ES forecast, positive EUR |
| `pnl_eur` | DOUBLE | Realised hypothetical P&L on forecast_date |
| `loss_eur` | DOUBLE | -pnl_eur |
| `is_breach` | BOOLEAN | Loss exceeded VaR |
| `excess_loss_eur` | DOUBLE | Loss beyond VaR on breach days, else 0 |
| `breaches_last_250d` | INT | Breaches in the trailing 250 backtest days |
| `traffic_light_zone` | STRING | Basel zone on the trailing 250 days: GREEN, YELLOW, RED or WARMING_UP |

## `gold_backtest_summary`

*gold delta table, risk job: `src/market_risk/jobs/compute_risk.py`*

Backtest statistics per portfolio, method and confidence level over the full history.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `portfolio_id` | STRING | Portfolio |
| `method` | STRING | Risk model (FK gold_dim_risk_method) |
| `confidence_level` | DOUBLE | VaR / ES confidence level, e.g. 0.99 |
| `start_date` | DATE | First forecast_date in the backtest |
| `end_date` | DATE | Last forecast_date in the backtest |
| `n_observations` | INT | Backtest days |
| `n_breaches` | INT | Days the loss exceeded VaR |
| `expected_breaches` | DOUBLE | n_observations * (1 - confidence_level) |
| `breach_rate` | DOUBLE | n_breaches / n_observations |
| `kupiec_lr` | DOUBLE | Kupiec POF likelihood ratio (chi2, 1 df) |
| `kupiec_pvalue` | DOUBLE | Kupiec POF p-value |
| `christoffersen_lr` | DOUBLE | Christoffersen independence likelihood ratio (chi2, 1 df) |
| `christoffersen_pvalue` | DOUBLE | Christoffersen independence p-value |
| `conditional_coverage_lr` | DOUBLE | Kupiec + Christoffersen (chi2, 2 df) |
| `conditional_coverage_pvalue` | DOUBLE | Conditional coverage p-value |
| `breaches_last_250d` | INT | Breaches in the latest 250 days |
| `traffic_light_zone` | STRING | Basel zone for the latest 250 days |
| `es_ratio` | DOUBLE | Mean loss on breach days / mean ES on those days |
| `model_result` | STRING | ACCEPT if Kupiec and conditional coverage pass at 5%, else REJECT |
| `computed_at` | TIMESTAMP | UTC time the risk job ran |
| `run_id` | STRING | Risk job run identifier |
